name: Pirater le Noyau
source:
When Chiko, a young Code Wielder (aka VR Hacker), receive a mission from a mysterious man, he must stop terrorists from taking over Orobis City by hacking Marlie’s Core!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/918140/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
奇科是一名年轻的代码操纵者（也称VR黑客）。当他收到神秘男子的任务后，必须通过黑入玛莉的核心，阻止恐怖分子接管奥罗比斯城！

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/918140/]Steam[/url]）
